segment_findings.reason: The rider was asked before the segment and agreed to a specific named road: 18:12 driver asks 'can I go round via Lower Delta Road?' and 18:13 the rider answers 'Sure, no problem.' — a rider message sent before the 18:17 segment start [F9][F10][F11][RD-5]. The whole way along the agreed run is therefore exempt.

That agreement was given at 18:13 for the first diversion only; no rider message before the 18:26:25 segment start authorises a second one, and the driver's own post-trip statement calls it 'my GPS rerouting', i.e. his own choice not an agreed route [F9][F10][F12][RD-5]. The complaint likewise says the second off-route part was never asked about, and the chat record is complete (two messages, all timestamped) so nothing is hidden by a partial log [F11][RD-5]. No qualifying incident excuses this stretch — a speed band alone does not [F13][F14][F15][RD-4]. Its 1.70 km extra is unexcused [F4][RD-1].
